alina: FYI ran into a subtle SDK parity issue: JS helper + jsonMode accepting malformed object because helper coerce + retry flow runs in the wrong order. Python path rejects correctly.

alina: repro (short):
```js
// helper config in sample-app
makeFnCallHelper({
  name: 'update_settings',
  arguments_schema: { type: 'object', properties: { ttl: { type: 'integer' } }, required: ['ttl'] },
  coerceTypes: true
})
// model in jsonMode returns { ttl: "3600" } (string)
// JS helper coerces post-parse to number but that happens after retry wrapper serializes -> ends up as string in DB
```

omar: hmm, did the retry-wrapper stringify the parsed object? we had a bug that the high-level retry took the helper return value and wrapped it as text on the JS path.

sasha: can you paste SDK versions and samplekit scaffold version? we fixed a similar one but maybe not this permutation.

alina: js@2.4.0-snapshot, py@1.10.2, samplekit v0.24. logs show sequence: parse -> coerce -> return -> retry wrapper serializes -> retry -> SDK sends stringified JSON. Py parses and sends object directly.

kevin: plan: 1) short-term change sample scaffolds to set coerceTypes=false when jsonMode=true; 2) change retry wrapper to run on raw bytes/string BEFORE helper logic, and ensure helpers parse/validate/coerce before any retry serialization; 3) add strictTypeEnforcement flag for helpers that opt into exact typed enums/ints.

omar: i think step 2 is safest: helpers should own parsing/coercion lifecycle, retry should only re-run the model call, not reserialize helper outputs. Otherwise helpers must be idempotent wrt string/object.

sasha: also add a lint in scaffold generator that warns if coerceTypes===true while jsonMode===true. lots of customers scaffold sample-apps and won't notice.

alina: created minimal failing test and pushed to samplekit branch; CI shows node12+k8s matrix failing same way. gist: <link>

ci-bot: CI failed: samplekit/integration fncall-jsonmode matrix (run 7829). See https://ci.internal/7829 for logs.

kevin: i'll open a small patch to parseBeforeRetry in the JS SDK helper runner and add a unit test that asserts typeof helperResult === 'object' after helper processing and before retry serialization. also will add `strictTypeEnforcement` as opt-in in helper ctor.

sasha: can we make strictTypeEnforcement default=true for function_call helpers? breaking risk but favors safety. proposal: default=true for server-side scaffolds, lint for client libs, and document migration path.

omar: agree on safer default. add a migration note in SDK changelog and samplekit release notes.

alina: thanks — will file DEVEX-1134 to track scaffolding change + lint + SDK fix + tests.

kevin: PR in flight, will ping thread when green.

alina: re-run tests after green and marking triage label `devex:fncall-json`.
